description: This file defines data types, request/response structures, and error handling for a VISS (Vehicle Information Service Specification) version 2 API, including serialization/deserialization logic, unique identifiers, and response traits.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Enumeration of different request types (get, set, subscribe, unsubscribe) with associated data.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Trait implemented by various response types to ensure serializability.

classes.name: GetRequest
classes.description: Structure representing a get request with path, request ID, optional authorization, and filter.

classes.name: GetSuccessResponse
classes.description: Enum for successful get responses, either data or metadata.

classes.name: DataResponse
classes.description: Response containing data for a get request, including request ID and data payload.

classes.name: MetadataResponse
classes.description: Response containing metadata for a get request, including request ID and metadata map.

classes.name: GetErrorResponse
classes.description: Response indicating an error occurred during a get request.

classes.name: SetRequest
classes.description: Structure for a set request with path, value, request ID, and optional authorization.

classes.name: SetSuccessResponse
classes.description: Response indicating successful set operation with request ID and timestamp.

classes.name: SetErrorResponse
classes.description: Response indicating an error during set operation.

classes.name: SubscribeRequest
classes.description: Subscription request structure with path, request ID, and optional authorization.

classes.name: SubscribeSuccessResponse
classes.description: Response for successful subscription, including subscription ID and timestamp.

classes.name: SubscribeErrorResponse
classes.description: Response for subscription errors.

classes.name: SubscriptionEvent
classes.description: Event data for an active subscription, including subscription ID, data, and timestamp.

classes.name: SubscriptionErrorEvent
classes.description: Event data for subscription errors.

classes.name: UnsubscribeRequest
classes.description: Request to unsubscribe with request ID and subscription ID.

classes.name: UnsubscribeSuccessResponse
classes.description: Response confirming successful unsubscription.

classes.name: UnsubscribeErrorResponse
classes.description: Response indicating an error during unsubscription.

classes.name: GenericRequest
classes.description: Generic request structure with optional action and request ID.

classes.name: GenericErrorResponse
classes.description: Generic error response structure.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Enumeration for request filters, currently only static-metadata.

classes.name: StaticMetadataFilter
classes.description: Structure for static metadata filter parameters (currently empty).

classes.name: RequestId
classes.description: Unique identifier for requests, serialized as a string.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Path representation as a string, identifying data nodes.

classes.name: SubscriptionId
classes.description: Identifier for subscription sessions, serialized as a string.

classes.name: Timestamp
classes.description: Timestamp wrapper around SystemTime, serialized to ISO8601 format.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Enum for data payloads, either object or array of objects.

classes.name: DataObject
classes.description: Data item with path and data point.

classes.name: DataPoint
classes.description: Data point with value and timestamp.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Variant for data values: None, Scalar string, or Array of strings.

classes.name: MetadataEntry
classes.description: Enum for different metadata types: branch, sensor, attribute, actuator.

classes.name: BranchEntry
classes.description: Metadata for a branch node, with description and children.

classes.name: SensorEntry
classes.description: Metadata for a sensor, including datatype, description, and optional properties.

classes.name: AttributeEntry
classes.description: Metadata for an attribute, including datatype, description, and optional properties.

classes.name: ActuatorEntry
classes.description: Metadata for an actuator, including datatype, description, and optional properties.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported data types.

classes.name: ErrorSpec
classes.description: Structure for error details: number, reason, message.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Enumeration of various error types with associated data.
